decisive_spans.text: A 3 cm left cerebellar hemispheric mass with surrounding vasogenic edema
MRI of the brain demonstrated a cystic enhancing lesion in the left cerebellar hemisphere with mass effect

response.rationale: The patient has a history of metastatic prostate cancer and imaging findings consistent with a brain metastasis in the cerebellum. While hemangioblastoma was considered, the history of metastatic prostate cancer makes brain metastasis a more likely diagnosis.
